name: jeyabbalas
description: Jeya Balaji Balasubramanian's agent skills as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: jeyabbalas-skills
plugins.description: Guided three-pass deep reading of academic papers, producing an interactive, printable reading library — plus a handoff skill that makes a conversation portable to another agent, schemify, which turns bespoke data dictionaries into validated, browsable JSON Schema packages, and chapterhouse, which turns whole academic books into a chapter-by-chapter guided study with spaced revision and self-assessment.
